description: Awarding contracts for Phase 2 of the Central Expressway Project -                 Section 3
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited under the National Competitive Procurement Procedure under 07 contract packages using government funds through competitive procurement among qualified local contractors for the implementation of Phase 2 (from Rambukkana to Galagedara) of Section 3 of the Central Expressway Project from Ch.13+800 km to Ch.32+450km. Accordingly, 06 bidders have submitted bids for Packages 2A, 2B, 2C and 2F, 05 bidders for Package 2D, 04 bidders for Package 2E and 03 bidders for Package 2G. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to award the relevant contracts, based on the recommendations of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:

Awarding the Construction of Package 2A to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.14.90 billion (excluding VAT).


Awarding the Construction of Package 2B to M/s K.D.A. Weerasinghe & Company (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.14.71 billion (excluding VAT).


Awarding the Construction of Package 2C to M/s International Construction Consortium (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.14.12 billion (excluding VAT).


Awarding the Construction of Package 2D to M/s Nem Construction (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.16.39 billion (excluding VAT).


Awarding the Construction of Package 2E to M/s Access Engineering PLC for a sum of Rs.18.70 billion (excluding VAT).


Awarding the Construction of Package 2F to M/s Edward & Christie (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.14.52 billion (excluding VAT).


Awarding the Construction of Package 2G to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.19.10 billion (excluding VAT).
